<security_assessment>

<details>
The PKGBUILD follows standard Arch packaging practice. It fetches the declared upstream source from the project’s GitHub repository over HTTPS, pins it with a SHA-256 checksum, and builds two Go binaries with CGO disabled. The build and package functions only compile the upstream code and install the resulting binaries plus the license file into `$pkgdir`.

No obfuscated commands, unexpected downloads, credential access, or system modifications are present. The use of `go build`, `install`, and standard package variables is consistent with normal AUR packaging.
</details>
